payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count leaves and non-leaves via degree array; compute closed-form using exponentation: (l * 2^(n-l+1) + (n-l) * 2^(n-l)) mod 1e9+7.
payload.rationale: Solution is combinatorial math on tree structure, not a dynamic programming algorithm. Allowed families are only DP; dp_tree is least mismatched due to tree context, but family_mismatch is flagged.
